Because the defender answered the witnesses pressed against the chain and neither withdrew nor suffered refutation of the declared links, the defense holds ([L4]).","rule_words":"This is about one verse. It does not apply when the judge weighs two chains.","room":"when the judge weighs two chains: one reading is that the judge here compares the challenger’s demonstrated argument with the defender’s chain, so the exception applies; the other is that the judge is only assessing one chain against witnesses, so K-S2 would apply.","why":"The judge’s holding rests on weighing the challenger’s demonstrated argument against the defender’s answered and unrebutted chain, so the single-verse rule does not govern."}
